backtest.method: Weekly. IC = correlation between the signal and the next period’s volatility-scaled return over T-bills (0.05 is useful, 0.10 strong). Ranking = assets in the top third by the blended signal minus the bottom third, rebalanced every 4 weeks.

alts.name: Gold
alts.role: Hedge against falling real rates, currency debasement and crises. No yield.
alts.india: Gold ETFs on NSE/BSE; MCX futures

alts.name: Silver
alts.role: Part precious, part industrial (solar, electronics). Roughly twice as volatile as gold.
alts.india: Silver ETFs on NSE/BSE; MCX futures

alts.name: Platinum
alts.role: Industrial precious metal (autocatalysts, hydrogen). Small market.
alts.india: No Indian ETF; overseas funds only

alts.name: Brent crude
alts.role: Global oil benchmark. Hedges supply shocks and inflation surprises; hurts oil importers such as India.
alts.india: MCX crude futures (WTI-linked)

alts.name: WTI crude
alts.role: US oil benchmark; the CFTC data for crude positioning.
alts.india: MCX crude futures

alts.name: US natural gas
alts.role: Henry Hub gas: weather and LNG exports drive it. Among the most volatile commodities.
alts.india: MCX natural gas futures

alts.name: Copper
alts.role: Bellwether for global industry and electrification (grids, EVs, data centres).
alts.india: MCX copper futures

alts.name: Wheat
alts.role: Food inflation; weather and Black Sea supply. Weakly linked to stocks.
alts.india: Domestic wheat futures suspended by SEBI until March 2027

alts.name: Corn
alts.role: Feed and biofuel demand; US weather.
alts.india: Maize futures trade on NCDEX but are too thin for institutional size

alts.name: Broad commodities
alts.role: Diversified futures basket (energy-heavy). The standard inflation-hedge sleeve.
alts.india: Overseas funds only

alts.name: Global REITs
alts.role: Listed property worldwide: rent income with inflation-linked leases, but rate-sensitive.
alts.india: Overseas fund of funds (within the MF cap), GIFT City or LRS

alts.name: US REITs
alts.role: The deepest REIT market (data centres, towers, warehouses, housing).
alts.india: Overseas fund of funds, GIFT City or LRS

alts.name: Indian REITs
alts.role: Grade-A offices let to global companies. Proxy: Embassy Office Parks REIT, India’s first listed REIT.
alts.india: Six listed REITs on NSE/BSE: Embassy, Mindspace, Brookfield, Nexus, Knowledge Realty and Bagmane

alts.name: Listed infrastructure
alts.role: Utilities, toll roads, airports and pipelines: regulated, often inflation-linked cash flows.
alts.india: InvITs on NSE/BSE for domestic exposure

alts.name: US TIPS
alts.role: US government bonds indexed to CPI: locks in a real yield and hedges inflation surprises.
alts.india: Overseas funds only

alts.name: US high yield
alts.role: Sub-investment-grade corporate bonds: equity-like in sell-offs, bond-like otherwise.
alts.india: Overseas funds only

alts.name: EM sovereign debt (USD)
alts.role: Dollar bonds of emerging-market governments: Treasuries plus a spread for country risk.
alts.india: Overseas funds only

alts.name: Private credit (listed BDCs)
alts.role: Floating-rate loans to mid-sized US firms. Listed BDCs give a daily price that private funds do not show.
alts.india: Category II AIFs (domestic private credit); overseas funds only for US

alts.name: Private equity (listed)
alts.role: Listed PE managers and holding companies: a liquid proxy with equity beta above 1.
alts.india: Category I/II AIFs domestically

alts.name: Managed futures (trend)
alts.role: Trend-following funds, long or short across futures markets. Their record years were 2008 and 2022, both equity bear markets.
alts.india: Category III AIFs; overseas funds only

alts.name: Bitcoin
alts.role: Scarce digital asset with no cash flows. Moves with global liquidity and risk appetite.
alts.india: No SEBI-regulated product; gains taxed at 30% plus 1% TDS

alts.name: Ether
alts.role: Native asset of the Ethereum network. Higher beta than bitcoin.
alts.india: No SEBI-regulated product; gains taxed at 30% plus 1% TDS

limits.note: Doubled from US$750 million in May 2021, after talks with the RBI.

limits.v: US$250,000 per person per financial year, across all purposes
limits.note: TCS on investment remittances: nil up to ₹10 lakh a year, 20% above it (adjustable against tax).

limits.note: The usual route for large Indian allocations to global assets when the MF cap binds.
